anatomy: T-Rex: two hind legs, two front arms SHORTER than his own head; pterodactyl two legs two wings
motion_rule: T-Rex drives every beat with his whole bulk; the pterodactyl works huge at the lens and touches him in his beats; the tiny arms always fall short
camera_moves: low angle, camera always moving, new framing every beat: push on the headbutt, arc on the swipe, orbit on the turn, low push on the meat with his head in frame, slow creep to his snout at the end
character: grumpy elderly T-Rex, thick wrinkled hide, enormous head, comically tiny front arms
cast: one T-Rex, one pterodactyl vendor, huge at the lens when he appears; no other characters
props: ONE flat stone slab on the ground as the counter, one level; wooden price board, one big numeral 500, no letters; one slab of meat, put on the stone at 4.85, torn away at 8.4
environment: clear noon, riverside meadow, short grass; dust stays at ground level
lighting: blazing noon sun overhead, bright throughout, hard crisp shadows, rim light on his back and jaw, grass bounce fills his face

audio.delivery: grumpy gravelly old male voice, steady 4.5 syllables per second, never hurried
audio.pronunciation: natural native Russian stress, no accent
audio.pacing: one unbroken phrase per window, no pause where a phrase carries across two windows, silence in every wordless beat
audio.lip_sync: jaw works each syllable, mouth free of props while he speaks, voice always from the T-Rex, never off-screen
audio.sfx: board clatter on stone 0.0 and 2.5;meat slap on stone 4.85;wing slap and jaw clack 8.4;stone grind and board thwack on his snout 9.1

timeline.a: he headbutts the board on the stone, it flips a body length up and slaps back down
his head snaps up off the stone, torso rocking back on his heels
he jabs a tiny arm at the board, comes up short, rocks his whole bulk forward, arm churning empty air
he misses again, loses balance, steps sideways; pterodactyl huge at the lens snatches the board off the stone and shoves it at his cheek
he turns his whole bulk to camera, head leading; pterodactyl is knocked spinning off him, the board clattering back onto the stone
the tail whips round and sweeps the board off the stone, it tumbles to the ground
he treads the board into the dirt, lifting his snout; pterodactyl huge at the lens slaps the slab of meat down on the stone
he lunges both tiny arms at the meat, chest tipping forward, claws closing a palm's width short
he drops his whole bulk down over the stone, snout sliding along it to the meat, jaws closing on it as the last word lands
pterodactyl rips the meat from his jaws, slaps a wing across his snout and bolts sideways out of frame; his head jerks after it, jaws clacking on air
he shoves the bare stone with his snout, it grinds round; the pinned board springs from under his foot onto his nose, he rears his whole head back and the board slides down his snout to his eye

must_appear: T-Rex acting every beat; front arms shorter than his head; ONE stone slab counter; board with numeral 500; meat on the stone 4.85-8.4; pterodactyl huge at the lens in his beats
negative_prompt: cyrillic, letters, words, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dim light, lamp light, moody lighting, low key lighting, dark scene, human hands, second dinosaur, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, slow motion, slow speech, static camera, T-Rex standing still, long front arms, arms longer than the head, stacked counters, tiered shelves, floating props, duplicate props, pterodactyl small in the background, accented Russian
